admission.loadToleranceRule: per load count: |median legacy - median port| <= max(loadTolerance x the larger median, loadAbsoluteSlack[count]); small integer counts get an absolute slack instead of a meaningless 10% of 4
admission.overheadControl: each side runs one extra trial per cell with the minimal recorder (overheadMetric only) next to its full-recorder trials; raw samples of both are kept; a difference above the bound refuses the cell; nothing is subtracted
